items.stem: A provision under IAS 37 is recognised only when which conditions are all met?

options.text: A present obligation from a past event, a probable outflow, and a reliable estimate
options.rationale: Correct: all three recognition criteria must hold.

options.text: Management merely expects a future cost
options.rationale: An expectation of future cost is not a present obligation.

options.text: A possible obligation that might arise
options.rationale: A possible obligation is a contingent liability, not a provision.

options.text: Any uncertainty in a future period
options.rationale: Uncertainty alone does not meet the recognition test.

items.explanation: Correct: recognition needs a present obligation from a past event, probable outflow and a reliable estimate.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO treatments are correct for an item that is only a contingent liability? (Select TWO)

options.text: Do not recognise it as a liability on the balance sheet
options.rationale: Correct: contingent liabilities are not recognised, only disclosed.

options.text: Disclose it in the notes unless the outflow is remote
options.rationale: Correct: disclosure is required unless the possibility of outflow is remote.

options.text: Recognise it as a full provision immediately
options.rationale: Contingent liabilities are not recognised as provisions.
A contingent liability is never an asset.

items.explanation: Correct: a contingent liability is disclosed (unless remote) and not recognised.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source
items.scoring: all-or-nothing on the exact key set

items.stem: How should a material, long-dated provision be measured under IAS 37?

options.text: At the present value of the best estimate, discounting for the time value of money
options.rationale: Correct: material long-dated provisions are discounted to present value.

options.text: At the undiscounted total of expected payments
options.rationale: Discounting is required where the time value is material.

options.text: At zero until the obligation is settled
options.rationale: The obligation is recognised when criteria are met, not deferred.

options.text: At the highest possible outcome always
options.rationale: Measurement is a best estimate, not the worst case by default.

items.explanation: Correct: where material, provisions are measured at the discounted present value of the best estimate.
